description: This file defines the 'Tax' class within the Opencart System Library Cart namespace. It provides methods for handling tax calculations, including setting addresses, retrieving tax rates, calculating taxes, and managing tax data. The class interacts with the database to retrieve tax rules and rates relevant to shipping, payment, and store addresses.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Handles tax-related calculations and data management within the Cart system, including fetching rates, calculating taxes for given values, and managing address-specific tax rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tax class with database and configuration objects retrieved from the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address by retrieving applicable tax rules based on country and zone IDs.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment address and retrieves corresponding tax rules for the specified country and zone.

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets the store address and fetches applicable tax rules based on country and zone IDs.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including tax based on a value, tax class ID, and whether to perform the calculation.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Retrieves the total tax amount for a given value and tax class ID.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Returns the name of a tax rate based on its ID.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves detailed tax rate data applicable for a given value and tax class ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the stored tax rates data.
